reasoning: We prioritized open findings that actively lie on paths from the internet to the organization's crown-jewel data store (org_a:ds:00001), as computed by attack path analysis. Findings with high CVSS scores that do not lie on any attack path were excluded. The fix_set corresponds to the minimum cut required to disconnect all internet-based attack routes to the crown jewels.
